lede: Notre Dame carries the stronger underlying team rating — +14.8 against +1.3, a 13.6-point separation on a neutral field before home advantage, travel or rest.
EdgeDesk makes it North Carolina +18.7 before any sportsbook number is consulted, with Notre Dame winning 89% of simulations.

Data confidence on this matchup is 84% — high by this board’s standards, so the margin is the strongest part of the read.
